meta.scope: GX + PSS transponders. PSI-M sleds, PSS-x and PSS-HC line cards are out of scope for v1.

hosts.name: G31
hosts.depthNote: Needs more than 600 mm. Open rack, or 700 mm+ depth — not a closed 600 mm cabinet.

hosts.name: G32
hosts.depthNote: Needs more than 600 mm. Open rack, or 700 mm+ depth — not a closed 600 mm cabinet.

cascade.label: 16P200
cascade.note: 12x SFP+/SFP28 plus 2x QSFP28 client, 2x QSFP28 line at OTU4. The standard way to land a handful of 10G services next to a coherent card in the same PSS shelf.

cascade.label: UCM4
cascade.note: G42 only, and only to feed a CHM6 / CHM7 (or a later G42 card). 10x client cages, 4x 100G line pluggables.

cascade.label: UTM2
cascade.note: The G31/G32 answer. 2x QSFP28 + 12x SFP+ client, 2x CFP2 line. Two slots wide — on a 4-slot G31 that is half the chassis.

wson.note: L0 GMPLS / WSON restoration requires a PSS photonic line system. The transponder itself stays flexible — a GX sled can ride a PSS line system as an alien wavelength — but the ROADM/OLS layer has to be PSS.
